items.title: How Tamil actor M.R. Radha got away with staging a ‘banned’ play in 1959
items.sum: In April 1959, the Madras Government banned actor M.R. Radha's play Thooku Medai for outraging religious feelings. Radha then obtained a police license for a new play titled Kathal Bali and staged it in Washermenpet on July 19, 1959. Police registered a case after finding it similar to the banned drama, and a magistrate fined Radha 200 rupees. The Madras High Court upheld his conviction in July 1962, noting that the plot and characters were identical. However, the judge set aside the fine and released Radha with a warning because the police commissioner had mistakenly granted a license for the performance.
